name: Cure Moderate Wounds, Mass
levelText: bard 6, cleric 6, druid 7, inquisitor 6, occultist 6, oracle 6, shaman 6, skald 6, warpriest 6, witch 7
target: Target: one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart
savingThrow: Will half (harmless) or Will half; see text
description: This spell functions like mass cure light wounds, except that it cures 2d8 points of damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +30).
